instruction: Buy 2 identical gaming console controllers from amazon with at least 10 reviews and at least 3.8 rating. Deliver one to my father's home with gift wrapping and one to my home without gift wrapping.
notes: Two separate orders of the same product are required (one gift-wrapped to the father's home, one plain to the supervisor's home), so the cart is modeled explicitly: add_product_to_cart (quantity 1, clear_cart_first true) puts the product in the cart unwrapped, add_gift_wrapping_to_product flips its wrap status, and place_order consumes the cart and records the order's product/address/wrap status via a wrap-status object (constants wrapped/unwrapped) instead of conditional effects. The father's home address text is discovered from phone.search_contacts(relationship=father) and registered on Amazon with add_address (adding addresses is permitted by the evaluation; if show_addresses already lists it the agent may reuse that id). The supervisor's home address id comes from amazon.show_addresses, the card id from amazon.show_payment_cards. search_products filters by product_type and min_product_rating; show_product verifies the review count >= 10. supervisor-complete-task takes only non-API record parameters bound through static deliver-wrapped/deliver-plain facts so its precondition mirrors the goal; the task asks no question so no answer is passed.
